description: Points d'eau Billon (1726-1728) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. La digitalisation des points d'eau Billon a été obtenue par l'identification minutieuse sur le plan raster de 1726-1728 des fontaines et des puits. Seules les informations fournies par le plan Billon sont prises en compte. Les symboles retenus sont le triangle pour les fontaines et la sphère pour les puits. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
